description: Who sells wholesale power TO a given counterparty — the reverse of eqr_contracts_search. Aggregates FERC EQR contracts by seller for a counterparty name match, returning each seller's contract count, the quarter range they appear in, and the distinct products sold. Answers "who sells power to PacifiCorp" / "which generators have contracts with <utility>" directly, which a single-table filter cannot (it needs a group-by across all matching contracts). Sourced from FERC EQR via PUDL (CC-BY-4.0), Phase 1 (contract terms only).

counterparty.description: Counterparty/customer company name, substring match, e.g. "PacifiCorp".
